newsitem.title: TAIWAN: TAIWAN DOLLAR SINKS SHARPLY ON U.S. DLR STRENGTH.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN DOLLAR SINKS SHARPLY ON U.S. DLR STRENGTH.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar sank sharply against its U.S. counterpart in early trade on Friday as the greenback's worldwide strength triggered hectic buying despite the central bank's late Thursday defence, dealers said.
After 30 minutes at 0130 GMT, the local unit was at T$28.730 against Thursday's T$28.639 close.
Turnover through dealers was active at US$93 million.

Dealers said strong intervention orchestrated by the central bank in the final seconds of Thursday's trade had reeled the Taiwan dollar back from the brink of a nine-year low close, concocting a slightly firmer finish.
But the intervention did not dampen buying sentiment for the greenback, dealers said.
"The U.S. dollar is just very strong all over, and there really isn't any room for the Taiwan dollar to rise," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
She said the central bank likely would step in again if the slide continued.
